title: A MIDDAY MOMENT
WITH PSALM 63:1
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: sunlight streaming through a window onto a wooden desk
calm golden hour light on a meadow at midday
close up of a single open journal on a desk
soft light reflecting on water surface
gentle breeze moving wheat in an open field
dust motes dancing in a sunbeam inside a room

scenes.a: Stop everything you are doing right now.
Take a deep breath and center your heart.
O God, you are my God, earnestly I seek you; my soul thirsts for you, my body longs for you, in a dry and weary land where there is no water.
In this middle hour of the day, bring your thirst to the only One who satisfies.
May your spirit be refreshed as you rest in His presence away from the rush of the world.
Subscribe to The Midday Watch to pause and pray with us again tomorrow.
